pages.title: Amsterdam/Binnenstad
pages.extract: The Binnenstad is the medieval heart of Amsterdam. It is where most foreign visitors arrive and leave, and has a lot of the city's prime attractions.

pages.title: Barcelona/Sants-Montjuïc
pages.extract: Sants-Montjuïc is a district in the southwest of Barcelona. Many of its attractions focus on the Parc de Montjuïc, which has museums, a castle, Olympic facilities and some great views overlooking the city. The district also contains the high-speed rail train station.

pages.title: Bardufoss
pages.description: urban area in Målselv Municipality, Norway
pages.extract: Bardufoss is a small town and the centre of the municipality of Målselv, Troms. It has grown together with the nearby village of Andselv. It has an important regional airport and a large airbase, beautiful pine forests, the wild meandering Malselv river, and is close to Dividalen National Park.

pages.title: Bislama phrasebook
pages.extract:
Bislama is a pidgin language used in Vanuatu and is now a creole in urban areas. Closely related but not identical to Tok Pisin in Papua New Guinea and Pijin in the Solomon Islands, it combines a typically Melanesian grammar with a mostly English vocabulary. It is the only language that can be understood and spoken by the whole population of Vanuatu, generally as a second language. 
It is a mixture of phonetic English woven in a loose French sentence structure spoken with ‘local sound' producing some comical outcomes e.g., a lady's brassiere or bathing top is called "basket blong titi"; no offense intended. An excellent Bislama dictionary is available from good book shops: 'A New Bislama Dictionary,' by the late Terry Crowley.

pages.title: Dhanbad
pages.extract:
Dhanbad is a city in Jharkhand; it is considered the coal capital of India.
The coalfields around Dhanbad are known as the Jharia coalfields. They cover an area of around 448 km2, the total reserve of coal is estimated at 5,000 million tonnes. Jharia coalfields are the only major source of coking or metallurgical coal in the country. There are 112 coal mines in the district. Jharia town adjacent to Dhanbad is considered a separate town administratively. Munidih Colliery is the largest colliery in India. ONGC is using CBM (Coal Beded Methane) for producing electricity at many places of Dhanbad. Tata Power along with DVC is setting up a 1050 MW thermal power plant in Dhanbad. It has chemical plants, other industries, and produces mica and many different minerals.

pages.title: Holton
pages.description: human settlement in Jackson County, Kansas, United States of America
pages.extract: Holton is a city in Eastern Kansas. It has a population of 3,329 with a population density of 1,233.0/sq mi it has an elevation of 1,093 ft.

pages.title: Hurtigruten
pages.description: Norwegian freight and passenger shipping service along Norway's western and northern coast between Bergen and Kirkenes

pages.title: Kent (British Columbia)
pages.description: district municipality in British Columbia, Canada
pages.extract: Kent is a municipality of 6,000 people (2016) north of the Fraser River in the Fraser Valley region of British Columbia.  It lies north of Chilliwack and south of Harrison Hot Springs and includes the unincorporated villages of Agassiz and Harrison Mills.

pages.title: Kundapur
pages.extract: Kundapur is a popular town in Udupi district of Karavali refion of Karnataka, India, known for its unique dialect of Kannada and great food.

pages.title: Marmara (island)
pages.description: island off the northwestern coast of Turkey

pages.title: Morni
pages.extract: Morni is a village (hill station) located in the Morni Hills in Haryana.

pages.title: Odia phrasebook
pages.extract: Odia (natively ଓଡ଼ିଆ, and formerly known as Oriya) is an Indian language, belonging to the Indo-Aryan branch of the Indo-European language family. There are about 40 million Odia speakers, mainly in the Indian state of Odisha. The language is also one of the many official languages in India.

pages.title: Puerto de la Cruz
pages.description: municipality in Santa Cruz de Tenerife Province, Canary Islands, Spain
pages.extract: Puerto de la Cruz (sometimes abbreviated to Puerto Cruz on road signs or Puerto in everyday language) is a city on the island of Tenerife. It is more family-friendly than the other tourist areas of Tenerife. It is also the longest-established and most complete of all resorts on Tenerife. The old part of the town retains beautiful spots, one of the few places where the locals still work, eat, and drink. Much of the area around the old fishing port is full of narrow, cobbled streets, lined with colonial architecture.

pages.title: Sechin
pages.extract: Sechin is 5km SE of Casma, a city on the Panamerican Highway in Peru's Northern Coast.

pages.description: city in Blount County, Tennessee, in the southeastern United State

pages.title: Ustronie Morskie
pages.description: village in West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
pages.extract: Ustronie Morskie is a resort town in the Zachodniopomorskie voivodeship in northwestern Poland. It is situated at the coast of Pomerania at a wide sandy beach.

pages.title: Vidzeme
pages.description: Historical and cultural region of Latvia
pages.extract: Vidzeme (sometimes Livonia) is a region in northeastern Latvia, bordering Estonia.

pages.description: moorland area in North Yorkshire, England, part of a National Park

pages.title: Rho
pages.description: municipality in the metropolitan city of Milan
pages.extract: Rho is a city in Milan Province, in the Lombardy region of Italy.

pages.title: Kunnamangalam
pages.description: town in Kozhikkode District, Kerala, India
pages.extract: Kunnamangalam is a big town in Kozhikode District, in Malabar region, Kerala state, India.

pages.title: Taoyuan
pages.extract: Taoyuan City (桃園) is a special municipality in Northern Taiwan, adjacent to New Taipei in the north and Hsinchu County in the south. It is the home of Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, which serves Taipei.

pages.title: Alipurduar (district)
pages.extract: Alipurduar (আলিপুরদুয়ার Ālipurduyār) is a district of North Bengal, at the foothills of the Himalayas.
